rev.t: I absolutely adore this spot! 🤩 It's wonderfully quiet, making for a peaceful treat. The ice cream itself is truly mouthwatering 🍦, a flavor explosion with every spoonful. I wholeheartedly recommend stopping by to experience these incredible sundaes! 🥭✨ …

We were driving by and saw the Polar Bear that's opened past 12.30am! Good service. All regular options are there. They have road side parking. Not so sure if the street packs up during the day, but late nights, its pretty empty.
Ordered one of the special -mango kulfi which came with kulfi at bottom, whipped cream and mango on top with sauce. It was ok as kulfi did not taste that good for the price paid
